frontend_smoke.evidence: In-app Browser offline smoke for the always-available referral Copy link action. At the default desktop viewport, all 10 free questions were completed with an Earth answer, the preview revealed, and the share card rendered as a 1080x1350 blob with enabled Share image, Download, and Copy link controls and no horizontal overflow. Copy link wrote exactly https://yourloveelement.com/?utm_source=share_card&utm_medium=referral&utm_campaign=organic_share&utm_content=result_card to the browser clipboard and displayed the success status; no answer, element, email, session, reading, order, or customer identifier appeared. At 390x844, Copy link spanned the full 328px share panel, document scroll width equaled the 390px viewport, and the 1080x1350 preview remained intact. The page used script.js?v=20260731-copy-link-1, kept the production API disabled, and produced no console errors. The localhost server log contained only local page/assets and no API request. This digest invalidates the evidence on later frontend changes.

paid_flow_e2e.evidence: Narrow digest waiver for an always-available frontend referral Copy link action that does not alter checkout creation, payment verification, paid-answer submission, webhook handling, queueing, report generation, Resend delivery, or any customer response. The runtime change only copies the existing fixed privacy-safe four-UTM referral URL; it does not emit a copy analytics event or mutate the native image payload. Automated coverage verifies the exact URL, excludes private identifier keys, and rejects an inflated share_card_link_copied event. Offline browser QA completed the 10-question Earth preview, generated the 1080x1350 card, copied the exact expected URL at desktop, and verified the full-width control at 390x844 with the production API disabled, no horizontal overflow, no console errors, and no API requests. No Lemon Squeezy transaction, webhook, report, or email was created; production payment/email E2E remains separately unauthorized, so this waiver is SKIPPED evidence rather than deployment or fulfillment proof. Any later paid-flow digest change invalidates this waiver.
